verdict.rationale: Codex documents running many cloud tasks in parallel, splitting larger work across subagents, and calling `codex exec` non-interactively from scripts and CI pipelines. Together these let users fan work out across many items, but the evidence shows no dedicated bulk or batch operation that acts on many items in one command. Missing for 10: an explicit batch/bulk command or API for applying one operation across many items (repos, issues, files), documented limits or progress handling for bulk runs, and independent hands-on corroboration of large-scale parallel use.
